description: Security profile for Rental Equipment Tracking & Condition Logging (RETCL)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.YardWorker
scopes.description: Yard Worker - Scan QR/barcode, return inspections, damage photos

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Dispatcher
scopes.description: Dispatcher - Rental check-out, equipment transfers, override reason

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Technician
scopes.description: Technician - Workshop repair orders, release from quarantine

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.BillingClerk
scopes.description: Billing Clerk - Review repair bills, adjust charges, dispute charges

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manager
scopes.description: Fleet / Operations Manager - All approvals, pricing rules, executive dashboards

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Administrator - System configuration and user management

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Auditor
scopes.description: Auditor - Read-only access to immutable condition logs and S/4 outbox

role-templates.name: YardWorkerRole
role-templates.description: Role for Yard Workers performing inspections

role-templates.name: DispatcherRole
role-templates.description: Role for Dispatchers managing contracts & check-outs

role-templates.name: TechnicianRole
role-templates.description: Role for Workshop Technicians maintaining equipment

role-templates.name: BillingClerkRole
role-templates.description: Role for Billing Clerks handling customer repair invoices
